title: Blamed on Bad Air
sentences: Medieval doctors were sure the plague spread through bad air.
In 1348, the medical faculty of Paris blamed a meeting of three planets.
People burned herbs, carried flowers and avoided foul smells.
The real cause, a bacterium, wasn't identified until 1894.
Follow for more from the Black Death.
